Hosted transcription now runs on Parley's own streaming protocol, and Parley Cloud can tell which feature used your AI credits.

**Transcription** (#593)

- Signed-in (hosted) transcription for meetings, uploads and voice typing now uses Parley's own stream protocol. Nothing changes in how you use it; the service behind it can now be improved without an app update.
- Stopping a meeting or a dictation waits for the server to confirm the last words instead of guessing from silence, so the tail of what you said is not cut off.

**AI credits** (#598)

- Hosted AI calls now say which feature they belong to (voice typing polish, Ask, meeting analysis, report), so credit usage can be broken down per feature. Calls made with your own API keys are unchanged.
